title: Come Up & Come Up With
situation: A new problem during the shift and a team solution.
objective: Use come up and come up with to talk about new problems and ideas.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: Sometimes a new problem comes up during the shift.
dialogue.indonesian: Terkadang masalah baru muncul selama shift.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: When that happens, I tell my supervisor right away.
dialogue.indonesian: Ketika itu terjadi, saya langsung memberi tahu supervisor saya.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: After we check the machine, we try to come up with a solution.
dialogue.indonesian: Setelah kami memeriksa mesin, kami mencoba menemukan solusi.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: If I come up with a good idea, I share it with the team.
dialogue.indonesian: Jika saya mendapat ide yang bagus, saya membagikannya kepada tim.

learningNotes: come up berarti muncul, biasanya untuk masalah atau situasi baru.
come up with berarti menemukan ide atau solusi.
Setelah come up with, gunakan benda: come up with a solution.
